chapter: Sam Morgan, repertoire and Silver Leaf
title: The Capitol boat: a strict reading band
summary: His one night on the Capitol was a reading band using stock arrangements; only three or four bands he knew had special arrangements.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: What was it like to work on that capital boat?

Oh, it was fine. I think it was nice to work on her, you know. But it wasn't so nice for me, because that was my first night and only night there, you see. You know, I feel a little skeptical about these things.
Well, yeah, I worked pretty hard. Well, that band was strictly a reading band.
Yeah, well yeah, yeah. They did. They did none at all by that. That is they all had it in front of them. I didn't get them to look.
Did they use stock arrangements or did they have special arrangements?
No, they used stock arrangements. Yeah, they used them.
How many bands did you play with that had special numbers arranged from?
Well, I don't know, I'll say about three or four. That's all right.
They have their own arranges in the band?
Did you ever write any of them?
No, on a copy. I was writing on a copy.
